This pathway ultimately leads to the interaction with Dehydrogenase/reductase SDR family member 9. The scores indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, suggesting that metronidazole may modulate the activity of SDR family members through the intermediation of Tankyrase-2 and 2-methylheptyl propanoate.
